title: Clionidae platform refresh before legacy archival
content:
Clionidae had a late-day refresh to bring the template library up to the current JeffersonWM platform instead of leaving it as a June-era snapshot. The work was mostly about truthfulness and usefulness: Clio should describe the patterns we were actually using, not just the patterns we once planned.

What changed:

  • Current platform language: the visible Clio pages and docs were updated to reflect central Auth / Multimillion, app memberships, popup/full-page auth handoff, richer Feed manual entries, public versions, buildlog/action records, backend sync, and public-only route guards.
  • Template scripts: Clio's package scripts were aligned with the newer app-local workflow: version helpers, prompted build logging, version history lookup, and publish commands.
  • Visual direction clarified: Clionidae was reframed as a standards and structure library rather than a shared house style.
  • Shell cleanup: the main Clionidae brand linked home, the Design page read Clionidae Visual + Design Library, footer credits linked to JeffersonWM Home and the GitHub account, and the About page/link were removed.

That August 14, 2026 pass is now part of the archive trail rather than an active public deployment plan. What worked was treating Clio as a memory aid for the whole platform. What did not need to continue was the assumption that it should remain a live public template site.

Verification passed with npm run lint and npm run build.
